definitions.explanation: Medicine taken to prevent nausea on a car, bus, ship or plane, usually before setting off.

examples.english: I took motion-sickness pills before getting on the boat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{酔|よ}い→酔う：14437_you⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{遠出|とおで}→遠出：14430_toode⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{酔|よ}い{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: My child gets carsick easily, so I always bring motion-sickness medicine on long trips.

notes:
⟦{酔|よ}い→酔い：31991_yoi⟧ (sickness, from ⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧) + {止|ど}め (stopping). Sold over the counter at every Japanese pharmacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take motion-sickness medicine
- {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: motion-sickness medicine
- {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the motion-sickness medicine works

WATCH OUT:
- {酔|よ}い{止|ど}め is for travel sickness, not for drunkenness; a hangover remedy is ⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧.
